digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport retry layer
propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiter returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After header, but rebar does not honour it and propagates the error immediately
429 retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only; mutations must not retry to prevent duplicate-write failures when 429 arrives post-write
the 429 retry opt-in must flow through two distinct call paths: PATH A via _call_logged for _paged_search calls, and PATH B via direct _with_connection_retry for per-issue comment fetches
Retry-After delay must be parsed from response headers, jittered up to 20%, and clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S; absent header degrades gracefully to non-retrying behaviour
four specific read call sites must opt in to 429 retry: get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map's _paged_search call, get_comment_map's per-issue fetch, and get_parent_map
